na-05Av.title: Road: divided road in savannah
na-05Av.summary: Road A1 between Windhoek and Okahandja runs through savannah and is one of only two divided major roads. The other is near Swakopmund, in dry coastal land with light sandy soil and dunes.

na-0a8T.title: Road: paved arid steppe, NW road angle
na-0a8T.summary: B1 between Mariental and Rehoboth: arid steppe, paved road and especially a northwest road angle, with the sun in the southeast.

na-0izS.title: Road lines: poor pavement, faded or no lines
na-0izS.summary: The C49 in the narrow northeastern strip often has poor pavement with only white lines, no lines, or faded lines on red-tinted pavement. A small section near Makolonga has good pavement and wide shoulders.

na-1eVI.title: Road: unpaved, cloudy sky, clears in south
na-1eVI.summary: The C14 is like the previous road but unpaved, with a blanket of cloud especially in the north, and a clear sky near the south end.

na-2yzK.title: Road: winding between table-topped mountains
na-2yzK.summary: East of Aus the road winds through table-topped mountains with the railway to the south. A similar view east of the D432 junction has bigger, closer, redder mountains.

na-3tsw.title: Landscape: more plants, pointed lone hills
na-3tsw.summary: Around Rehoboth the land gets greener, and towards Windhoek hills become more prominent, with pointed lone hills and ridges. Weather is clear with small clouds.

na-4SGm.title: Road: red grainy pavement, green grass, low clouds
na-4SGm.summary: The northern part of the C35 has red-tinted grainy pavement, green savannah-like grass and low cumulus clouds.

na-5v5U.title: Road: paved east, orange grass, rocky hills hug road
na-5v5U.summary: The paved C22 heads east with freshly cut orange grass and large rocky hills hugging the road near the middle, with a blinding low sun to the east. A short stretch near Okakarara was filmed at another time.

na-7T8C.title: Town: single flat-topped rocky hill
na-7T8C.summary: Ariamsvlei has a single flat-topped hill with rocky ridgelines near the top and a little green shrub on the slopes, to the north or east depending on where you are. Soil is dark red with bushes and small trees.

na-7cMz.title: Sign: green direction signs, yellow road number
na-7cMz.summary: Green direction signs with the road number in yellow, as in South Africa and neighbours. Roads are A, B, C, D, M and sometimes F. South Africa uses N and R roads.

differs.how: South Africa uses N and R road letters

na-8tHZ.title: Town: dark mountain north, dry hills south
na-8tHZ.summary: From almost anywhere in Karibib you see the dark silhouette of Erongo Mountain to the north, and dry shrubby hills south of town.

na-ANJr.title: Route marker: D-road first digit shows region
na-ANJr.summary: D-roads fall into four regions by their first digit. Three-digit numbers (like D203) are in the far south, and further north you get four-digit numbers starting with 1, 2, then 3.

na-B9nv.title: Road lines: northern roads without yellow edges
na-B9nv.summary: A few northern roads lack yellow edge lines: the C46 (northwest to southeast, with very poor pavement in the east-west part), part of the B10 west of Eenhana, and another part east of Nkurenkuru. The D3615 has very faded yellow ones.

na-BXmN.title: Landscape: farmland, very light sandy soil, fan palms
na-BXmN.summary: In the north, mostly around Oshakati, there is more farmland and very light sandy soil. It lines up with where Hyphaene fan palms grow.

na-BbVk.title: Road: wide unpaved sandy road lined with trees
na-BbVk.summary: The C44 is a wide unpaved sandy road lined with trees, heading east-southeast with westbound driving. The D3301 looks similar but has redder soil and the car drives east.

na-CqNa.title: City: north-south grid in red desert, blue bins
na-CqNa.summary: A large north-south grid city in the desert with red soil, many unpaved roads, and a faint green ridge to the north-northwest. Street signs are rare and green with silver framing. Blue bins are a clue.

na-EuPn.title: Road: light grainy pavement, very faded yellow lines
na-EuPn.summary: The D3600 and the unlabelled road northeast to Mpungu have light, sometimes grainy pavement and very faded yellow lines, running exactly north-south or northeast.

na-G0pP.title: Town: orange mountains covered in green plants
na-G0pP.summary: Opuwo is a partly hilly town surrounded by orange mountains covered in green plants, with a great viewpoint over them.

na-G6vI.title: Town: poorer coast town, mostly unpaved
na-G6vI.summary: Like the bigger coastal towns, but less gridded and poorer, with mostly unpaved roads. Yellow lamps appear throughout, not just downtown. Cloudy weather confirms it.

na-GQP9.title: Town: lone tall ridge with striated texture
na-GQP9.summary: A lone tall ridge with a rugged striated texture lies south-southeast of Usakos, with a smaller red-tinted mountain to the east or northeast. From the north, the cliffy edges of Erongo Mountain are visible.

na-GV6Y.title: Landscape: flat, dry, reddish soil, acacias
na-GV6Y.summary: East of Windhoek the land is flat and dry with slightly reddish soil, short golden grass, shrubs and acacia trees, much like Botswana.

na-HF3M.title: City: tall buildings, gated houses, white street signs
na-HF3M.summary: By far the largest and richest city, with high-rises downtown, affluent gated houses on hilly streets with simple white street signs, and slums on hills to the northwest.

na-Hg72.title: Driving side: left
na-Hg72.summary: Traffic drives on the left, like other southern and eastern African countries. All Middle Eastern countries with coverage drive on the right.

na-HyM3.title: Landscape: rugged mountains west of paved road
na-HyM3.summary: From the paved C13 a large rugged mountain formation shows to the west. Soil is light by the road and orange further away, with light green plants. Wispy clouds hiding the sun in the east also help.

na-IOve.title: Road: flat plateau, gentle incline, red soil
na-IOve.summary: After the road climbs onto the plateau east of Kuibis it looks flat until the D432 junction, but climbs gradually for long stretches. Soil is very red, with clear weather and distant clouds.

na-IkJb.title: Road lines: yellow edge, white centre
na-IkJb.summary: Most roads have single yellow edge lines and white centre lines. Other southern African countries also use single yellow edge lines.

na-J97p.title: Road: clear weather, wide shoulder lines, ENE angle
na-J97p.summary: East of Karibib the weather is completely clear, mountains are far off, and the wide shoulder lines and ENE road angle stand out.

na-JGXq.title: Landscape: tricky farm fields
na-JGXq.summary: Somewhat baity agricultural fields just west of Mariental.

na-KiJ5.title: Town: very rocky, bare hills all around
na-KiJ5.summary: Aus is very rocky with dry, bare hills around. Hills to the north are smooth and sloped, peaks to the south are more rugged.

na-KlCK.title: Landscape: wide valley with small green hills
na-KlCK.summary: The C39 runs through a wide valley with small green hills on both sides, mostly to the north, heading north-northeast with puffy clouds in a sunny sky.

na-LMYZ.title: Road: very red soil, golden grass tufts, dark clouds
na-LMYZ.summary: The paved C19 has very red soil, small tufts of golden grass beside the road and a mostly dark cloudy sky, especially in the north.

na-NUQc.title: Road: sandy soil, green plants, spotty clouds
na-NUQc.summary: The C38 is an ordinary paved northern road with sandy soil, short grass and a spotty blanket of cloud, with the sun faintly visible to the north.

na-NXKT.title: Town: far mountains all around, NE-SW grid
na-NXKT.summary: Otavi lies among many far-off mountains. It is green with slightly reddish sandy soil, and the whole town is on a northeast to southwest grid, which rules out similar towns like Grootfontein and Tsumeb.

na-OYpy.title: Bollard: white, two yellow reflectors, black sand
na-OYpy.summary: The C34 looks like darker streaks of black sand in more sand, sometimes with coastal shrubs or the coast. Unique white bollards with two yellow reflectors on the front stand along the road.

na-PiB6.title: Town: pink brick sidewalks, always overcast
na-PiB6.summary: A small resort town between two coastal cities with pink brick sidewalks along nearly every road. Weather is always overcast and gloomy.

na-QN1P.title: Landscape: tall pink sand dunes
na-QN1P.summary: Tall pink dunes are mainly just east of Sossusvlei and can be seen from afar on a few roads.

na-RnXY.title: Road: even wider unpaved road, redder soil
na-RnXY.summary: The C47 is wider than the C44 and has slightly redder soil. It heads northeast with the car driving southwest, under clear or wispy-cloud skies.

na-TqEE.title: Bollard: small stone bollards
na-TqEE.summary: Small stone bollards at junctions and along roads.

na-TsmB.title: Road: red tabletop mountains, wide gravel road
na-TsmB.summary: The C43 passes some of the most impressive red tabletop mountains, on a wide unpaved road of light gravel against the red land.

na-VnA8.title: Coverage: mostly main roads only
na-VnA8.summary: Coverage is mostly on main roads, with only sparse minor roads.

na-WPiJ.title: Plate: yellow front and back
na-WPiJ.summary: Mostly yellow plates front and back. Vanity plates are white with blue letters. Only Botswana and this country mainly have yellow rear plates in southern Africa.

na-WwD3.title: Road: empty paved east-southeast road
na-WwD3.summary: A lonely paved road heading east-southeast through flat, dry land with small clouds. Shrubs are quite green, especially in the hilly east. It differs from parts of the B4 by driving east rather than west.

na-X6Ct.title: Google car: where the car is blurred
na-X6Ct.summary: Whether the Google car is blurred narrows things down. In the north the blurred car is only northwest of Ondangwa. The blurred car on dirt roads suggests side roads. A blurred car often means 2024 coverage, so use with caution.

na-ZNXA.title: Road: sandy soil, ridge to the east
na-ZNXA.summary: The B2 northeast of Swakopmund has sandy soil, a mountain ridge to the east, and a few lone mountains northwest. Near the coast the sky is hazy.

na-ZRAe.hide: infographic map only, no learnable content in text

na-ZaFJ.title: Bins: round metal, green and white
na-ZaFJ.summary: Round metal bins, often painted green and white, at many rest stops and junctions. On some roads they are blue and white.

na-ZxG0.title: Town: gridded, lots of planted trees, Norfolk pines
na-ZxG0.summary: A well-off gridded town with almost exactly east-west streets and many planted trees, including Norfolk pines. Streets are E-W avenues and N-S streets, written on small blue markers by gates or on street signs.

na-axbq.title: Landscape: very rugged mountains to the west
na-axbq.summary: A very rugged mountain formation is visible to the west from a few sections of the C35 and its side roads.

na-cKwP.title: Town: light rocky hillsides everywhere
na-cKwP.summary: Light-coloured rocky hillsides are everywhere in the hilly coastal town of Luderitz.

na-cT5i.title: Road: light grainy pavement, ENE, green north
na-cT5i.summary: A long stretch of the B8 has light, grainy pavement, an east-northeast angle and a green, wooded northern landscape.

na-da0h.title: Landscape: greener hills with shrubs and trees
na-da0h.summary: In the northwest the land is somewhat greener, with hills covered in shrubs and trees.

na-eNdi.title: Google car: white pickup, short antenna leaning left
na-eNdi.summary: A white pickup with a short antenna on the front that always leans slightly left. No other southern African country has this car. Oman has a similar one, but its antenna never leans left and often leans right.

differs.how: antenna never leans left, often leans right

na-et4Z.title: Road: bright soil, clear sky, clouds over ridge
na-et4Z.summary: A paved road heading north-northwest with bright soil, clear skies and cloud over a tabletop ridge to the east.

na-fza8.title: Road: loses red pavement, sandy, SSE angle
na-fza8.summary: South of the C41 junction the road loses its red pavement and gets worse. Land is sandier with hills to the west, usually heading south-southeast, with scattered cloud. Further south it gets hillier.

na-gR4V.title: Coverage: sunrise with thin clouds
na-gR4V.summary: Between Karibib and Usakos, sunrise coverage with thin cloud, mountains to the north, small hills south of the road and flat land east-northeast.

na-hXYJ.title: Road: empty paved road through desert
na-hXYJ.summary: Road B1 south of Grunau is a lonely paved road going north-northeast through desert with only very low dry plants.

na-i6Sl.title: Landscape: dry mountains and hills in west and south
na-i6Sl.summary: Dry mountains and hills cover much of the west and south.

na-jDkd.title: Road: grainy pavement, soft grass, cumulus clouds
na-jDkd.summary: East of the C35 junction the road has a constant SW to NW angle and grainy pavement, with soft-looking grass, sandy soil and cumulus clouds. West of the junction the pavement and clouds stay but the land is hillier.

na-ke6W.title: Coverage: fully green grass and mountains
na-ke6W.summary: A pocket south of Tsumeb has the most lush coverage in the country, with completely green grass and mountains.

na-ksca.title: Town: dry mountains northeast and southwest
na-ksca.summary: Rosh Pinah is recognised by dry mountains just northeast of the town and further away to the southwest.

na-kvIP.title: Coverage: dramatic clouds and orange horizon
na-kvIP.summary: A short stretch northwest of Kamanjab in green hilly land with lots of clouds, the sun peeking from the west and orange hues on the horizon.

na-kwl9.title: Road: flat NW road with cumulus clouds
na-kwl9.summary: The C40 heads northwest through flat land with short grass, trees further off, hills in the distance and lots of cumulus clouds. Closer to Kamanjab the sun sits lower in the west.

na-kzLO.title: Road: flat with mountains close, long tabletop ridge
na-kzLO.summary: Between Seeheim and Keetmanshoop the land is flat with mountains always nearby: a short ridge and lone mountain northeast just east of Seeheim, a long tabletop ridge west, and a railway to the south.

na-ldeC.title: Road: blindingly bright sandy soil, railway south
na-ldeC.summary: The B4 east of Luderitz has very bright sandy soil, flat near the road with hills in the distance, and a railway along the south side. Near the coast it gets much hillier.

na-lm-463287.title: Phone numbers: area codes start with 06
na-lm-463287.summary: Area codes always begin with 06, then one digit for the area. Windhoek is 061.

na-lm-486399.title: Pole: three alternating insulators on top
na-lm-486399.summary: Three insulators sticking out horizontally and alternating at the top, found everywhere. A good clue for this country in a 50-50 against Kenya or Oman.

differs.how: use this pole as a tiebreaker
use this pole as a tiebreaker

na-lm-486400.title: Pole: horizontal bar with insulators like birds
na-lm-486400.summary: Usually one horizontal bar with thin white insulators that look like a row of birds, so called 'bird poles'. A good clue against Kenya or Oman.

differs.how: use this pole as a tiebreaker
use this pole as a tiebreaker

na-lm-486401.title: Pole: A-frame with insulators on a bar
na-lm-486401.summary: Three bars forming an A, with the bottom insulators at the ends of a horizontal bar, found everywhere. A good clue against Kenya or Oman.

differs.how: use this pole as a tiebreaker
use this pole as a tiebreaker

na-nOBK.title: City: flat coast town, sandy streets, palms
na-nOBK.summary: The two coastal cities are flat with sandy streets, palms and Norfolk pines, and square signposts. White and blue plastic containers are common, and yellow lamp posts downtown.

na-nVdM.title: Houses: German-style old buildings, German place names
na-nVdM.summary: A former German colony, so place names and some older buildings still look German.

na-nfvM.title: Landscape: red sandy ridges, rollercoaster roads
na-nfvM.summary: The southeast has countless small red sandy ridges running NW to SE. Roads that ride the ridges feel bumpy like a rollercoaster.

na-o3qt.title: Plants: tall lush trees both sides of the road
na-o3qt.summary: Roads with tall, lush trees on both sides are in the north. The greener and denser, the further north-northeast you should click.

na-of42.title: Town: crown-shaped mountain, white open pit mines
na-of42.summary: The crown-like outline of Mt Brandeberg is faintly visible northwest from most of Uis, with many dry hills around. White open pit mines show from the western half.

na-py4w.title: Road: northbound, flat, golden grass, acacias
na-py4w.summary: North of Okahandja, the B1 heads north with bright sun to the north-northwest and clear sky. It is flatter, with golden grass and green acacias. South of Sukses two pointy mountains lie west of the road.

na-q0wQ.title: Town: thatched fences on flat land, cliff to SW
na-q0wQ.summary: Noordoewer has the same thatched style but is built on flat land, with an imposing cliff across the border to the southwest and similar mountains north.

differs.how: cliff visible across the border in South Africa

na-qoqD.title: Road lines: missing yellow edge lines on B1 stretches
na-qoqD.summary: Yellow edge lines are missing on parts of the B1: between Grunau and Keetmanshoop (hillier, rougher road), a cloudy bit north of Keetmanshoop, and a flat north-northeast stretch between Gibeon and Mariental.

na-sBG0.title: Road: wide shoulders, excellent pavement
na-sBG0.summary: The B1 between Gibeon and Tses has wider shoulders and excellent pavement.

na-t3Ad.title: Landscape: dry rolling hills, yellow grass
na-t3Ad.summary: Around Windhoek, a small area of dry rolling hills with yellow grass and dead-looking bushes and small trees.

na-uGWG.title: Town: deep light sand streets with tyre tracks
na-uGWG.summary: Most streets in Rundu are deep, light-coloured sand with a bumpy texture and engraved tyre tracks. Not entirely unique.

na-vIAf.title: Plants: vineyards
na-vIAf.summary: Vineyards only grow around Aussenkehr on the South African border in the south.

na-veEz.title: Town: orange thatched fences and huts on a slope
na-veEz.summary: Orange thatched fences, walls and huts are everywhere in the desert town of Aussenkehr, built on a hill slope.

na-xMHW.title: Landscape: sandy coast with dunes
na-xMHW.summary: Sandy coastal land with a few dunes around and north of Swakopmund, plus two small pockets near Luderitz and Oranjemund in the south.

na-yt7p.title: Road: eastward, orange soil, always cloudy
na-yt7p.summary: Road B6 heads east from Windhoek, hilly near the city and flatter near Gobabis. Soil is orange with short green grass, and the sky is never clear. The C39 is similar but has brighter soil.
